standard.summary: GLoKr（Kronecker 参数化广义适配器）训练完成后的保存格式：lora_compatible（默认）导出为 ComfyUI/A1111 可读的标准 LoRA；native 保留 Kronecker 原生布局。
standard.effect: lora_compatible 把 Kronecker 分解的 delta 权重展开/折算为 lora_up/lora_down；native 保存原始因子矩阵，仅本训练器可加载。
standard.whenToUse: 产物面向通用推理生态时保持默认；需要继续训练 GLoKr 或研究其因子结构时选 native。
standard.avoidWhen: lycoris_algo 不是 glokr 时不参与；native 产物无法在第三方推理端使用。

standard_en.summary: The save format after GLoKr (a Kronecker-parameterised generalised adapter) finishes training: lora_compatible (the default) exports a standard LoRA that ComfyUI and A1111 can read; native keeps the Kronecker layout.
standard_en.effect: lora_compatible expands or folds the Kronecker-factorised delta weights into lora_up/lora_down; native saves the original factor matrices, loadable only by this trainer.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep the default when the artefact is for the general inference ecosystem; choose native when you will keep training the GLoKr or want to study its factor structure.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It does not apply unless lycoris_algo is glokr, and a native artefact cannot be used by third-party inference.

advanced.principle: GLoKr 用 Kronecker 积参数化 ΔW，参数量远小于同表达力的低秩分解；导出为 LoRA 格式需要把 Kronecker 因子乘开为稠密 delta 再做低秩表示，兼容性与文件体积/保真度之间取舍。
advanced.intervention: trainer_artifact_export.py 导出阶段按 export_mode 分支；config_adapter 系列归一化取值（非法值回落 native）。
advanced.expectedImpact: lora_compatible 即插即用；native 更小、保真、可续训。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 glora_export_mode 相同：归一化的非法值回落是 native，与 UI 默认 lora_compatible 不一致，配置来源不规范时可能意外得到原生导出。
advanced.codePath: trainer_artifact_export.py：glokr 导出分支；config_adapter_normalizers.py / config_adapter_conversion_runtime.py 归一化

advanced_en.principle: GLoKr parameterizes ΔW with Kronecker products, far fewer parameters than a same-capacity low-rank factorization; exporting to LoRA format requires multiplying the Kronecker factors out into a dense delta and then a low-rank representation — a trade-off between compatibility and file size/fidelity.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_artifact_export.py branches on export_mode at export; the config_adapter family normalizes values (illegal values fall back to native).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: lora_compatible is plug-and-play; native is smaller, faithful, and resumable.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Same as glora_export_mode: the normalization fallback for illegal values is native, while the UI default is lora_compatible — sloppy config sources can silently yield native export.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer_artifact_export.py: glokr export branch; normalized in config_adapter_normalizers.py / config_adapter_conversion_runtime.py
